Kit summary

Fish WaterballBasic
Deals 280% ATK DMG to a single enemy and refreshes the duration of all attribute debuffs. There is a 15% chance to act 1 extra turn after casting Fish Waterball proactively. This effect can be triggered continuously.
Clean OceanActiveExclusive Lv.3
Restores all allies' Max HP by 14%. Meanwhile, cleanses 5 layers of DoT debuffs and all attribute debuffs from all allies, and grants them 1 layer of [Block Removal] for 2 turns. [Block Removal]: Consumes 1 layer and invalidates the incoming Removal effect, up to 3 layers.
Pearl of Ocean Lv.3Clean Ocean also grants all allies [Consolidation II] for 2 turns and refreshes the duration of all buffs.
Fish GuardianPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies 2 layers of [Fish Shoal] at the beginning of each wave. Consumes 1 layer of [Fish Shoal] and restores self 4.8% of Max HP when the owner takes 1 stage of Direct DMG, up to 2 layers. Restores the ally's [Fish Shoal] to the layer cap at the beginning of the ally's turn.
Pearl of Ocean Lv.2Increases the layer cap of [Fish Shoal] to 3, and reduces the Skill DMG taken by 10% for allies who have [Fish Shoal].
Fish DiveActiveExclusive Lv.1
Restores all allies' [Fish Shoal] to the layer cap and restores their HP percentage to the same as the one with the most HP percentage among all allies. This skill CD cannot be affected by other effects.
Pearl of Ocean Lv.1Reduces the CD of all skills by 1 turn for all allies who have at least 1 layer of [Fish Shoal] before Fish Dive restores the layers of [Fish Shoal].
Source: game files.
